correctness.rationale: The resident boundary x=0 gives logistic F(n)=mu n(1-n) and a period-two pair n±=(mu+1 ±sqrt((mu-3)(mu+1)))/(2mu). The two-step resource multiplier 4+2mu-mu² has modulus<1 exactly for 3<mu<1+sqrt(6). At x=0 both type-I and type-II strategy maps have derivative S(n)=(1-n)alpha+n sigma and zero derivative in n, so the monodromy is lower triangular; transverse multiplier equals S(n-)S(n+)=[alpha²+(mu+1)(mu-2)alpha sigma+(mu+1)sigma²]/mu². It increases strictly in alpha, crosses one uniquely at alpha*>1; hyperbolic attraction/saddle claims follow in the stated strict regions, not at equality. Algebra gives the exact mean-variance identity Lambda_C=S(nbar)^2 -(alpha-sigma)^2(mu-3)(mu+1)/(4mu²), hence alpha_mean<alpha*. Under sigma>2/(mu+1) the strict physical interval exists. Independently evaluated exact rational witness mu=16/5,d=1/10,alpha=9/5,sigma=3/5 yielding 1593/1600 transverse, 4/25 longitudinal, 81/80 mean-game factor, and checked positive invariance bound (mu+d)²<4mu. These computations corroborate, not replace, Floquet proof.
